name: Pauper Commander
description: Commander-style format where the deck and Commander must be cards printed at common rarity (in supported printings). Decks are 100 cards, singleton rules apply, offering a budget Commander experience.
rules_summary: 100-card singleton; Commander and deck cards must have common printings; commander color identity applies; format-specific ban list may exist.
main_rules: All cards must have been printed at common rarity
allowed_sets: Sets where a card had a common printing
